t: Letter Re Achilles George Dandria, Drugs Trafficker

pages.en:
D. 6431.

No. D ______
Date 26 / 1 / 35

January 26, 35.

My dear Steptoe,

I have to acknowledge receipt of
your letter dated January 18, 1935, regarding one
Achilles George Mandria, drugs trafficker, who may
come to Shanghai, and in reply, to inform you that
the Narcotics Section has been informed about this
person.

Should he arrive here at some future
date, a further communication will be forwarded to
you.

Yours sincerely,
J.W.G.

H.N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

日期 35年1月26日

1935年1月26日。

亲爱的 Steptoe：

兹确认收到您1935年1月18日来信，关于毒品贩子 Achilles George Mandria 可能前来上海一事。现复函告知，禁毒科已获知此人的相关情况。

若其日后抵达此处，将另行致函通知。

此致
敬礼
J.W.G.

H.N. Steptoe 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

U.P.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.

19th January 1935.

My dear Givens,

Will you please warn the Narcotics Section
that on 17th October 1934., a certain ACHILLES GEORGE DANDRIA
was bound over to be of good behaviour for two years by the
British Provincial Court, Alexandria, on a charge, that on
October 16th he contravened the Dangerous Drugs Regulation,
in that he did receive from one RENATO DEL BELLO (an Italian
subject), purser of the s.s. "Nil" two envelopes of heroin
which he was to deliver to another British subject one Spiro
G. Caprara (not arrested).

There are grounds for believing that Dandria's
Maltese friends are endeavouring to send him to Shanghai.
Dandria on 22nd November was in Port Said and he may come on
here.

Yours Sincerely,
H. L. Copley

美国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

1935年1月19日。

亲爱的 Givens：

请通知禁毒科，1934年10月17日，一名名为 ACHILLES GEORGE DANDRIA 的人在亚历山大英国地方法院因被指控于10月16日违反《危险毒品条例》而被责令具结保证良好行为两年。指控称，他从“尼罗河”号（s.s. "Nil"）轮船的管事、意大利籍人士 RENATO DEL BELLO 处接收了两包海洛因，并打算将其交付给另一名英国籍人士 Spiro G. Caprara（未被逮捕）。

有理由相信，Dandria 的马耳他朋友正试图将他送往上海。Dandria 于11月22日曾在塞得港，他可能会来此地。

此致
敬礼
H. L. Copley
